chapter: To the US and the Caribbean with Carmen and Rolando
title: Back to Puerto Rico and then Tropicana in Cuba
summary: After Santo Domingo they worked Puerto Rico again, then returned to Cuba and the Tropicana, doubling at radio CMQ.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Then, from Santo Domingo, where do we go?
What did you do in Puerto Rico, when you got back?

We worked in several . . . for example we worked in the Hipódromo Las Monjas it was called back then, and various cabarets. After there we left and returned to Cuba. I then returned to the Cabaret Tropicana.
And still with the same dance couple or?

Yes, with the same couple. In the Cabaret Tropicana, after the Tropicana I was moonlighting with the radio station CMQ. Doubling up at the radio station CMQ. Later I returned again to the United States.
